item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00458","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C23","C05","C04"],"selected_candidate_label":"C23","confidence":0.84,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C23 plausibly supplied a material template for the child’s government-wide management initiative. Both direct department and agency heads to appraise field or agency operations for greater economy and effectiveness, assign the Bureau of the Budget a guidance and coordination role, address interagency problems, and require later evaluation and recommendations. C05 and C04 also contain relevant regional, intergovernmental, and interagency coordination machinery, but their specialized public-works and natural-resources programs are less closely aligned with
